name: 宁海崇兴庙戏台
subject: 宁海崇兴庙戏台与勾连廊
structure: the photographed CENTER theater stage and its directly attached covered passage with three linked caisson ceilings. Draw only this coupled timber stage-and-passage unit, its red timber columns, open square stage, carved beams and ceilings in the same interior view. No surrounding detached audience buildings, no neighboring hall reconstructions.
materials: worn dark brown and red timber with restrained gold and painted carved ceiling details, grey stone base
era: 清代 · 现存单体确年未详
yearNote: 1700仅作清代约略排序；创庙与戏台后世修缮分别理解，具体建年尚未确定。
facts: 戏台与勾连廊连设三座藻井，为宁海三连贯藻井戏台之一。
寺庙与宗祠沿革不等同于现存戏台确切建年，本条按清代约略定位。
戏台与勾连廊视为一个连体单元，不与岙胡及城隍庙戏台混为一条。
